 Most recent Most popular Post published at 14:36 GMT 14:36 GMT 
 FT: Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Manchester United have failed to win in their last 7 games in the Premier League; their last longer winless streak was from 1 April 2025 to 16 May 2025, a run of eight games.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Carrick has done everything right by his club' published at 14:34 GMT 14:34 GMT 
 FT: Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 A penny for Michael Carrick's thoughts, he's done everything right by his club.
 There must be anger and frustration running through his bones because he's a Man United person. 
 237 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:33 GMT 14:33 GMT 
 FT: Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Now the players head over to the travelling fans as they take it all in. 
 Bruno Fernandes looks like he's close to tears.

 FT: Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Michael Carrick looks like a defeated man.
 He's heading straight over to the travelling fans, who are singing his song.

 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Manchester United go nine games without a win as Chelsea take all three points.

 get involved Get Involved published at 14:29 GMT 14:29 GMT

 39 years since Sir Alex was appointed United manager. Don’t forget he was on the brink of getting sacked after four years of not much.
 Graham, Essex 
 1042 438 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 90+10 mins 90+10 mins 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United

 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 It should be 3-0. 
 Valentin Barco arrives at the far post but he can't keep his effort down. 
 Lovely ball in from Malo Gusto, though.

 A Halloween to forget for Michael Carrick.

 SUBSTITUTION published at 90+7 mins 90+7 mins 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Cole Palmer ends his game with a goal from the spot as he is replaced by Geovany Quenda for the final few minutes.

 Post published at 14:26 GMT 14:26 GMT 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Mark Schwarzer 
Former Chelsea goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Stamford Bridge 
 I think Estevao has been very good. Very dangerous down the right-hand-side, he has caused all sorts of problems for Manchester United. 
 664 104 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 90+6 mins 90+6 mins 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 And the corner comes to absolutely nothing. 
 207 247 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Man United get in their own way' published at 14:24 GMT 14:24 GMT 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 It's a club that for so many years has looked like it's getting in its own way. 
 Patience is required, which is difficult when a club like United has had so much success and has so many expectations. 
 449 179 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 90+5 mins 90+5 mins 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Leny Yoro reads the ball into the box and knocks it behind for another Chelsea corner. 
 241 54 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Easier to replace manager than whole team' published at 14:23 GMT 14:23 GMT 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Mark Schwarzer 
Former Chelsea goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Stamford Bridge 
 It is easier to replace a manager than replace the whole team. 
 Unfortunately, when clubs do make the decision, generally it is the manager to go.
 For me, this is not on Michael Carrick. It is a senior player being sent off, which is crazy.
 1336 98 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Absolutely perfect' published at 14:23 GMT 14:23 GMT 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 That is difficult to take, he meets it absolutely perfect. What a strike from Bryan Mbeumo. 
 347 181 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 90+4 mins 90+4 mins 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Josh Acheampong has the freedom of Stamford Bridge as he strides forward. 
 The ball finds Cole Palmer in the D but he sweeps his effort over the top. Poor. 
 160 131 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HITS THE WOODWORK published at 90+3 mins 90+3 mins 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 My word! What a hit that was from Bryan Mbeumo. 
 He hits it first time on the bounce and he's almost snapped the crossbar in half. 
 Image source, Getty Images

 Post published at 90+2 mins 90+2 mins 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Joshua Zirkzee does well to find a yard of space for an effort on goal but Levi Colwill sticks with him to make the block.

 We're into 10 minutes of added time.
 Don't think anyone expected that.
